map.数据明明不服从正态分布怎么办？: What if the data clearly does not follow a normal distribution?
map.先检验再套用。可用直方图、Q-Q 图或 Shapiro-Wilk 等检验判断；若: Test before applying. Use a histogram, Q-Q plot or tests such as Shapiro-Wilk; if clearly skewed or heavy-tailed, forcing a normal model badly underestimates extreme value probabilities (common in finance and latency data). Alternatives include a log or similar transform, or switching to the t or lognormal distributions.
